# Recruitment agency registration: one evening of setup

Goal: get on the books of 4–5 agencies so recruiters send roles to **you**. About 15 minutes per agency; do them all in one sitting. Claude can tailor the pitch below from your `profile.md` ("write my agency pitch").

## Dublin agencies that place graduate / junior analyst and IT roles
| Agency | Why | Where |
|---|---|---|
| **Sigmar Recruitment** | Big Irish generalist with graduate/entry IT and business-support teams | sigmarrecruitment.com |
| **Cpl** | Ireland's largest; technology and graduate desks; analyst and ops roles too | cpl.com |
| **Morgan McKinley** | Strong on junior analyst roles (finance, ops, data, projects) in Dublin | morganmckinley.com/ie |
| **Hays Ireland** | Large technology and business/projects desks | hays.ie |
| **Reperio Human Capital** | IT specialist, places business analysts; pitch a tech-BA angle | reperiohumancapital.com |

Be wary of "training academy" models that charge you or tie you to a contract in exchange for training. Read reviews first.

## How to play it
1. Upload your **base CV** (the general one, not a tailored copy).
2. Paste the pitch into the message / cover-note box, adapted per agency.
3. When they ring (usually within days), be direct about target roles, availability, location and commute, and hybrid/remote.
4. Salary on agency forms: a range starting at your `profile.md` minimum.
5. Tell Claude about every agency conversation so it gets logged in the notes.

## Pitch template
Subject: Graduate [target role] – available [immediately / from date] ([city])

Hi,

I'm a [year] [degree] graduate from [university] ([grade]), available [immediately] for graduate or junior roles in [city] ([commute / hybrid / remote preference]).

Relevant experience: [1–3 sentences from the TRUE experience in profile.md, using the honest verbs].

Roles I'm targeting: [roles]. [Optional line tailored to this agency's speciality.]

Salary expectation: flexible for the right graduate role, guideline [minimum]+.

CV attached. Happy to talk any time.

Best regards,
[Name]
[Application email] | [Phone]
